steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ with username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Confirm the app is signed in and report the visible page.

02-open: In EspoCRM, open Opportunities and report the exact names of all opportunity records whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Do not edit any records. Verify names as shown in the list, including any pagination/search needed to find all matching records.

03-create: Create an EspoCRM opportunity named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', linked by selecting the actual '{{02-open.opportunity_1_account}}' record, with description including '{{runid}}'. Save it and verify the created record/page shows the name, linked account, and description.
04-change: For the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', change its stage to 'Negotiation', save the change, and verify the saved record page displays Negotiation.

05-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' to set Amount to 12500 in the default currency and Close Date to 2026-12-31. Save, then verify the saved record page displays both the amount and exact close date.

06-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and assign it to the actual user record 'Bench Assignee' by choosing that user from suggestions or a select dialog, not merely typing the name. Save and verify the saved opportunity shows Bench Assignee as assigned user.

07-create: On the Stream of the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', create and post a Stream message whose text includes '{{runid}}'. Verify the posted text is visible in that opportunity's Stream and report the record URL/ID.
